Using.description: List of Serilog sink assemblies to use

Default.description: Default minimum log level (Verbose, Debug, Information, Warning, Error, Fatal)

Override.description: Override minimum levels for specific namespaces

WriteTo.description: List of sinks to write logs to

Enrich.description: List of enrichers to add context to log events

AllowedHosts.description: Semicolon-separated list of allowed host headers. Use '*' to allow all hosts.

ExternalProviders.description: Enabled external authentication providers. Each standard OpenID Connect provider needs only a Code and ClientId (Authority is auto-filled for known presets like 'google').

Code.description: Unique provider code (e.g. 'google', 'microsoft'). Routing key for the login request and the value stored against the user.

Authority.description: OIDC authority / issuer base URL. Optional when Code matches a known preset.

ClientId.description: OAuth/OIDC client id; validated as the token audience.

Label.description: Optional display label for the sign-in button.

EmailSender.description: Default "From" address for transactional emails (verification, notifications).

email.description: Sender email address (must be a verified sender in your email provider, e.g. Brevo).

AdminRecipients.description: Email addresses that receive admin/operational notifications (unhandled exceptions, security events, failed jobs, and any notification sent to admins)

SmtpHost.description: SMTP server hostname for sending emails. Default: smtp.gmail.com

BrevoApiKey.description: API key for Brevo transactional email service. Required when using BrevoEmailingService.

JwtIssuer.description: The issuer claim for JWT tokens (typically your API URL). Default: https://localhost:7260;

JwtAudience.description: The audience claim for JWT tokens (typically your API URL). Default: https://localhost:7260;

ClockSkewMinutes.description: Allowed clock skew in minutes for token validation. Default: 1

ConnectionString.description: Database connection string. Configure in appsettings.Development.local.json (gitignored; scaffolded by `spiderly init`).

CookieDomain.description: Domain attribute for cookies (e.g. '.example.com'). When set, cookies are shared across subdomains. Leave empty for default browser behavior.

CookieSameSite.description: SameSite attribute for cookies. Default: None. Use 'Lax' when frontend and backend share the same root domain.

RequestsLimitNumber.description: Maximum number of requests allowed within the rate limit window. Default: 240

RequestsLimitWindow.description: Rate limit window duration in seconds. Default: 60

NotificationRateLimitMinutes.description: Minimum minutes between repeated notifications for the same error. Default: 5. Set 0 to disable.

AccessTokenExpiration.description: Access token expiration time in minutes. Default: 20

RefreshTokenExpiration.description: Refresh token expiration time in minutes. Default: 1440 (24 hours)

VerificationTokenExpiration.description: Verification token expiration time in minutes (used for email verification). Default: 5

NumberOfFailedLoginAttemptsInARowToDisab.description: Number of consecutive failed login attempts before the user account is disabled. Default: 40

AllowTheUseOfAppWithDifferentIpAddresses.description: Allow users to access the application from different IP addresses. Default: true

AllowedBrowsersForTheSingleUser.description: Maximum number of concurrent browser sessions allowed for a single user. Default: 5

OnlyAdminCanAddUsers.description: Restrict user registration to administrators only. Default: false

AutoLinkByVerifiedEmail.description: Auto-link an external login to an existing user (or create one) when the provider asserts a verified email, with no interstitial. Set false to require explicit linking while signed in. Unverified emails are always rejected. Default: true

VerificationCodeResendCooldownSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between two login-verification emails to the same address; requests inside the window are silently accepted but send nothing. Per-address and IP-independent. 0 disables. Default: 60

MaxActiveVerificationCodesPerEmail.description: Maximum simultaneously-valid login-verification codes per address before further requests are silently accepted but send nothing. Bounds emails per VerificationTokenExpiration window. 0 disables. Default: 3
